what_changed_en.description: One or two plain-English sentences on what the edit did.

evidence.description: 1-4 spans copied verbatim from the removed/inserted text or summaries.

claim_en.description: The asserted claim as one neutral English sentence, or null.

claim_fi.description: The same claim in Finnish, or null.

narrative_en.description: Short label of the broader storyline, or null.

historical_note_en.description: Only if the claim contradicts well-established history; else null.
